(Cleveland, Ohio) | college = [[Akron Zips men's basketball|Akron]] (2019–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 50 | draft_team = [[Indiana Pacers]] | career_start = 2024 | years1 = {{nbay|2024|full=y}} | team1 = [[Indiana Pacers]] | years2 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team2 = →[[Indiana Mad Ants]] | years3 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team3 = [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] | years4 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025]]–present | team4 = →[[Iowa Wolves]] | highlights = * [[Associated Press|AP]] honorable mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2024 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2024]]) * [[Mid-American Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|MAC Player of the Year]] (2024) * 2× First-team All-[[Mid-American Conference|MAC]] (2023, 2024) * Second-team All-MAC (2022) * MAC Defensive Player of the Year (2022) * 4× MAC All-Defensive team (2021–2024) * [[List of NCAA Division I men's basketball season rebounding leaders|NCAA rebounding leader]] (2024) * 2× [[Mid-American Conference men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] MVP ([[2022 MAC men's basketball tournament|2022]], [[2024 MAC men's basketball tournament|2024]]) }} '''Enrique Gabriel Freeman''' (born July 29, 2000) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Iowa Wolves]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Akron Zips men's basketball|Akron Zips]]. ==College career== After a prep career at [[St. Martin de Porres High School (Cleveland)|St. Martin de Porres High School]] in [[Cleveland]], Freeman had no college basketball offers. He accepted an academic scholarship to the [[University of Akron]] and at the urging of friends and family, tried out for a [[Walk-on (sports)|walk-on]] spot with the school's basketball team, earning a roster spot. He played sparingly as a freshman, totaling 13 minutes on the season. He grew {{Convert|4|in|cm|spell=in}} between his first and second years and earned a scholarship and a starting role for the Zips. He earned his first [[Mid-American Conference]] (MAC) all-defensive team honor.{{cite web |last=Pluto |first=Terry |date=September 15, 2023 |title=Meet Akron’s Enrique Freeman: If you want to smile, read this story – Terry Pluto |url=https://www.cleveland.com/sports/college/2023/09/meet-akrons-enrique-freeman-if-you-want-to-smile-read-this-story-terry-pluto.html |access-date=January 2, 2024 |website=[[cleveland.com]]}} As Freeman established himself as one of the top defensive players in the MAC during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]], his offense began to develop as well. He averaged a [[double-double]] for the season and led the nation in [[field goal percentage]]. He earned second-team All-MAC honors and was named the conference Defensive Player of the Year. He led the Zips to a [[Mid-American Conference men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] title, and was named the tournament MVP.{{cite web |last=Beaven |first=Michael |date=March 16, 2022 |title='I am here and it feels great': Enrique Freeman leads Akron into NCAA Tournament |url=https://www.beaconjournal.com/story/sports/2022/03/16/enrique-freeman-akron-zips-ucla-ncaa-mens-basketball-tournament-east-region-john-groce-mac-champions/7032693001/ |access-date=January 2, 2024 |website=beaconjournal.com}} Following the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]], Freeman declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]] but retained his college eligibility. He worked out for several teams but ultimately decided to return to Akron for his senior season.{{cite web |last=Thomas |first=George M. |date=May 31, 2023 |title=Report: Akron Zips forward Enrique Freeman withdraws from the NBA draft |url=https://www.beaconjournal.com/story/sports/college/zips/2023/05/31/akron-zips-forward-enrique-freeman-pulls-name-from-nba-draft/70274479007/ |access-date=January 2, 2024 |website=beaconjournal.com}} Entering his final season at Akron, Freeman was named preseason All-MAC and added to the 20-man watch list for the [[Karl Malone Award]] for top [[power forward]] in the nation.{{cite web |date=October 26, 2023 |title=Freeman, Ali Named Preseason All-MAC, Akron Picked to Finish First |url=https://gozips.com/news/2023/11/1/mens-basketball-freeman-ali-named-preseason-all-mac-akron-picked-to-finish-first |access-date=January 2, 2024 |website=gozips.com}}{{cite web |last=Haley |first=Ryan |date=October 26, 2023 |title=Duke's Filipowski leads 20 power forwards on Karl Malone Award watch list |url=https://collegesportswire.usatoday.com/2023/10/26/ncaa-mens-baskeball-kyle-filipowski-karl-malone-award-watch-list/ |access-date=January 2, 2024 |website=[[usatoday.com]]}} On February 2, 2024, he was named to the 10-man finalist pool for the award.{{cite web |last=Thomas |first=George M. |date=February 2, 2024 |title=Akron Zips basketball forward Enrique Freeman up for Naismith Karl Malone Award |url=https://www.beaconjournal.com/story/sports/college/zips/2024/02/02/akron-zips-forward-enrique-freeman-up-for-naismith-karl-malone-award-mac/72449247007/ |access-date=February 13, 2024 |website=beaconjournal.com}} At the close of the regular season, Freeman was named [[Mid-American Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|MAC Player of the Year]].{{cite web |date=March 13, 2024 |title=MAC Announces 2023-24 MAC Men’s Basketball All-MAC Teams, Specialty Award Winners |url=https://getsomemaction.com/news/2024/3/12/mac-announces-2023-24-mac-mens-basketball-all-mac-teams-specialty-award-winners.aspx |access-date=March 13, 2024 |website=getsomemaction.com}} ==Professional career== On June 27, 2024, Freeman was selected with the 50th overall pick by the [[Indiana Pacers]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/nba/pacers/2024/06/27/pacers-take-akron-star-enrique-freeman-with-50th-pick/74161657007/|title=Pacers take nation's leading rebounder Enrique Freeman from Akron with 50th pick|website=IndyStar|last=Dopirak|first=Dustin|date=June 27, 2024|access-date=June 28, 2024}} On August 8, Freeman signed a [[two-way contract]] with them.{{cite web|title=Indiana Pacers Sign Freeman and Swider|url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/news/indiana-pacers-sign-freeman-and-swider|website=NBA.com|date=August 8, 2024|access-date=August 8, 2024}} Freeman made his NBA debut on October 23, in a 115–109 win over the [[2024–25 Detroit Pistons season|Detroit Pistons]], scoring 2 points.{{cite web|title=Indiana Pacers at Detroit Pistons Box Score, October 23, 2024|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202410230DET.html|website=BasketballRef|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=October 28, 2024}} On August 1, 2025, Freeman signed a two-way contract with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{Cite web |date=August 1, 2025 |title=Wolves sign Akron legend, Summer League star Enrique Freeman
